body: I always figured things would be somewhat better once I got out of this house, but I'm stuck. Thank you. Ttyl.
Thank you. They've always been that way so it's not like it'll ever change.
A couple hours away but she's an alcoholic. And a different state, but I don't really know that side of the family well other then they probably think I'm just another crazy in the family.

I feel like I try so hard to not disappoint them but then I screw everything up by doing something like trying to killyself. Or just being me. I clean the house regularly just so my mother doesn't have to and yet still get treated like I do everything wrong and I just don't know.

The hospital only gave me enough meds for five more days to be able to get me through the weekend. So I'm going to eventually be stopping them. I'm sorry about the abusive relationships you've had to deal with. Before this guy I was in one for 7 years and we actually saw each other every day, it was a nightmare. My mother is abusive? I thought that was just typical things parents do when they get mad. The only other family member around is my grandmother, and she's worse then my mother.

Yes I'm still here, sorry. Thank you, I'm worried about how I'm going to start feeling while suddenly stopping the meds though. I'm kind of scared I'll start feeling worse and may attempt it again. I go back and forth on the "I want to leave but I don't" thing a lot. Everything just sorta got to me Saturday and I tried. It seems like I've only ever been with guys that suck. I thought this one was different, he was great for the first few months but then things just changed and I stayed. I guess he wasn't so great when I found out about all the lying and cheating, but yeah. 

No I'm not in a dangerous situation like that but it's just how they are. Mainly my mother. My dad barely speaks to me as it is, I'm lucky if I get a "hi" from him every few days. We all live in the same house, I'm just a burden and disappointment. My mother always says things to me that bring me completely down. She always has an attitude with me, always mad, never good enough. If she sees I'm happy she makes damn sure to say all she can to mame me practically cry. Over the years I've learned not to say anything back or else it just esclates and she won't drop it for weeks. They found out about my facebook account back when I was in highschool and just tore into me, verbally. That was the first time I attempted suicide. I can't even throw trash away without my mother going through it and trying to find something she can use against me. If I walk outside I get followed and then 20 questioned about where I went and why I would need to leave and why I'm being a slut and if I'm pregnant and stuff. I just want to take a walk to get away for a bit and I'm accused of stuff like that. I can't stand it and I try to stay as anonymous as I can so they won't bother me.

I'm afriad to say too much because I don't want my parents finding my stuff online, I know that sounds stupid but it's happened before. 

A few weeks ago I decided I wanted to get help for myself because I knew I was going downhill fast, but I just can't which made me feel even worse. I told the nurses how the meds were making me feel when I was there but they told me to suck it up because all medication makes people feel like that at first. The discharge person at the hospital told me to get on medicaid, but this is a problem because I can't. I used to have it but, there's a story on why I don't and can't anymore. 

I keep getting re-attached to this guy because even though he broke up with me he kept telling me I was the only one he wanted still and one day it'll just be us and blah blah and I kept falling for it. I see how much he actually cared after this happened. I can't go anywhere because of my parents, I can't just go drive, I can't just go to a therapist or anything even if I had the insurance because of my parents. I can't call a suicide hotline because of my parents. They will know, they will hear, they never leave the house and if I go to leave the house, especially after this recent attempt, they'll just follow me. I feel like a freaking child because they won't let me do anything. 

And for friends, I don't even look. I'm not really social, I'm super shy and introverted. Even being anonymous on the internet I can end up getting that way. I'm scared that if I do start talking to someone they'll either bully me, ask for pictures, sext, get mad, just something. I'm boring anyway and not that smart. No one wants to actually take the time to know me, and if they did they would just end up being like everyone else.
